subject: Flyer question
text:
Hi,

Quick one before the meeting. I still haven’t finished the flyer edits because the sponsor logo came through blurry. Did you send the original file to the copy shop, or are you still waiting on the designer? If not, could you forward it soon? I need to swap it and check spacing tonight. Also, the donation totals on page two look off; were we supposed to include last month’s online gifts? Let me know and I can finish it today while I have the layout open.
